title: Menu Settings

placeholder.search: Search menu name or resource code
placeholder.name: Enter a name for this level

hint.saveWholeTree: Saving submits the whole tree at once, so renames and changes to visibility and order are all written together.
hint.dragSameLevel: Dragging only reorders items within the same level. To move an item to another level, use "Move to Another Level" on its row.
hint.fullNameAuto: Full resource names are built from the level names automatically. Renaming or moving an item also rewrites the names of the items under it.
hint.codeReadonly: Resources are created by the back-end seed data, and resource codes are read-only. You can't add or delete resources on this page.
hint.searching: Search only affects what's shown. Saving still submits the whole tree ({n} item in total). Drag-and-drop sorting is unavailable while searching. | Search only affects what's shown. Saving still submits the whole tree ({n} items in total). Drag-and-drop sorting is unavailable while searching.
hint.drag: Drag to reorder within the same level. To move across levels, use "Move to Another Level".
hint.dragDisabled: Drag-and-drop sorting is unavailable while searching
hint.codeLocked: Bound to endpoint permissions and maintained in the back-end seed data. It can't be changed here.
